Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Magnolia for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Photos with Santa at Spring Creek Growers) through December 18 (Winter Fest at Magnolia Bible Church), with December 2 (Santa Storytime at the Malcolm Purvis Library), December 5 (Magic of Christmas Parade of Lights) and December 16 (Grinch Storytime at the Malcolm Purvis Library) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Magnolia

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Magnolia
  • 5 free events, including the Magic of Christmas Parade of Lights, Holidays at The Havyn and Winter Fest at Magnolia Bible Church
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at Spring Creek Growers, Santa Storytime at the library
  • Parades and tree lightings: Magic of Christmas Parade of Lights
  • Kids' fishing: Tinsel and Tackle Kids Christmas Fishing at Spring Creek Growers
  • Season: November 27 to December 18

Planning a bigger day out? Magnolia families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
